input:
We enabled MIPI CSI-2 v4.0 Multi-Pixel Compression (MPC) on our sensor to reduce DDR bandwidth. With MPC enabled, raw captures show visible artifacts — horizontal color banding every 16 lines and magenta fringing on high-contrast edges.

dmesg:
  [  20.100] csi2_rx: MPC mode enabled, compression ratio=2:1
  [  20.101] isp_mpc_decoder: MPC frame received, mode=LOSSLESS
  [  20.102] isp_mpc_decoder: WARNING: block boundary artifact detected at line 16, 32, 48

The sensor transmits with MPC 2:1 compression. The ISP MPC decoder reports block boundary artifacts at 16-line intervals. What causes MPC decode artifacts, and is this a sensor-side or ISP-side configuration issue? What is MIPI-CSI2-MPC-Decode-Fail?
